title: Autotune: sensible defaults for batching & caching + quant profiles + unit-econ export tooling
author: Maya Singh
description: Motivation: reduce per-token unit cost and avoid manual tuning by shipping conservative, workload-aware defaults for batching and caching and a set of vetted quantization profiles, plus tooling to export unit-economics reports used by SRE and Finance. This PR bundles three related changes: 1) a new autotune defaults module that derives batching window, target batch size, and KV-prefix caching TTLs from observed latency/throughput distributions and tenant SLAs; 2) a set of recommended quantization profiles (int8, q4_k_m variants) with compatibility metadata and fallback rules; 3) a small command-line and HTTP exporter (uecon exporter) that generates per-route unit-econ reports (tokens, GPU-ms, estimated $ cost) for offline analysis and for the Console. Implementation notes: - Introduce src/runtime/autotune/auto_tuner.py implementing the defaults heuristics and a lightweight simulator used in CI to validate config changes against synthetic traces. - Add configs/quant_profiles.yaml with profile metadata and scoring heuristics for quality vs cost tradeoffs. - Wire defaults into runtime path in src/runtime/batching/defaults.py and caching/prefix_cache.py behind feature flag 'autotune_uecon_v1' (off by default for Dedicated customers). - Add pkg/uecon/exporter.py which can be run as a job or invoked from the Console backend to produce CSV/JSON reports. - Add unit tests and an integration smoke test harness in tests/ to validate no latency regressions at p95 on sample traces. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-9345) - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration smoke tests - [x] CI green - [x] Feature-flagged rollout plan - [x] Docs updated (ops) Rollout: behind feature flag and staged canary across 5% traffic, monitoring for p95 latency regressions and quality regression alerts tied to eval prompt sets. Backout plan: disable feature flag; fallback to previous static defaults. Impact: expected 6-18% reduction in token cost for batched workloads, small latency improvements for common short-seq traffic due to prefix caching improvements. See release_notes for details.

release_notes:
- Add autotune defaults for batching and KV-prefix caching to reduce per-token cost for common workloads.
- Ship curated quantization profiles (int8, q4 variants) with compatibility and fallback metadata.
- Add unit-econ exporter to generate per-route cost reports for ops and finance.
- Rollout behind feature flag 'autotune_uecon_v1', staged canary, and monitoring for p95 latency and eval-based quality regressions.
